description: This file implements the MediaPipelineModuleService class, which manages media pipeline sessions, client connections, and media source operations via IPC in a media server context. It includes methods for creating/destroying sessions, loading media, attaching/removing sources, playback controls, and retrieving media status.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IPC service for managing media pipeline sessions and media sources, handling client connections, disconnections, and media control commands.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating instances of MediaPipelineModuleService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connection, exports the service to the client.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, cleans up sessions associated with the client.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline session, assigns a session ID, and associates it with the client.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing session and removes it from client associations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media into a session based on provided parameters.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window parameters for a session.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session, constructing source objects based on request parameters.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback for a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback for a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback for a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position for a session.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates data availability for a session.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame for a session.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume for a session.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Sets the mute state for a session.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves the mute state for a session.
